versions.content: Handling if EthTrcv_MacSecAddTxSa is called and EthTrcvMacSecEnabled is available and set to TRUE Status: DRAFT If EthTrcv_MacSecAddTxSa is called and the following conditions are valid: • EthTrcvMacSecEnabled is available and set to TRUE of the EthTrcvConfig identified with the given TrcvIdx • a transmission secure association can be added to the given association number (see An ), i.e. the given association number is not occupied then the EthTrcv driver shall perform the following actions. Otherwise return with E_ NOT_OK : • create a transmission secure association at the PHY that corresponds to the given TrcvIdx by considering the given association number (see An ), the lowest acceptable packet number (see NextPn ), the short secure channel identifier (see Ssci ) and the secured association key (available via KeysPtr and addressed with SakKeyPtr ) • activate the created transmission secure association, if given API parameter Active is set to TRUE , otherwise deactivate the created transmission secure association • return with E_OK .
